patchNotes: Fixes custom clothing materials left white by applying the selected material to all renderers and material slots in the equipped item. Restores current model/material selections when entering gameplay without a named clothing preset. Adds audited support for Streets build 26150520 / 2.0.0.3070.0 and restores its native equip-completion hooks. Eyewear materials now persist. Selected textures were visually verified in the menu and gameplay; the reporting player's exact bundles and multiplayer remain unverified.
